proposals.proposed_text: The actor MUST deliver completions to a client's callback channel without blocking. Because a single actor thread serves all clients on a controller, it MUST NOT block delivering a completion to one client, as that would head-of-line-block completion delivery to every other client on the same controller. Completions that cannot be delivered immediately (callback ring full) MUST be buffered per-client in FIFO order and retried on subsequent poll cycles. Per-client backlog is bounded by that client's outstanding operations.
proposals.note: Completion enum derives Clone to enable non-consuming try_send.

proposals.title: Abort use-after-free: buffer released while NVMe command in flight
proposals.current_state: AbortOp removed the PendingOp (dropping its pinned DmaBuffer Arc) and acked immediately, without issuing an NVMe abort; the later hardware completion hit an unknown handle and was discarded. UAF if the client reclaimed the buffer while the command was still in flight.
proposals.proposed_resolution: Keep the PendingOp (and buffer) alive on abort; issue a real spdk_nvme_ctrlr_cmd_abort_ext matched by cmd_cb_arg; defer AbortAck until the original completion arrives, releasing the buffer only then. Unknown handle acked immediately (idempotent). Requires allowlisting spdk_nvme_ctrlr_cmd_abort_ext in spdk-sys/build.rs.
proposals.rationale: The spec-required abort was both memory-unsafe and a no-op against hardware. Fix aligns code to FR-005 and adds a buffer-lifetime contract.
proposals.verification: cargo build -p spdk-sys, cargo build -p block-device-spdk-nvme (+ --features telemetry), cargo test -p block-device-spdk-nvme (39 pass) all clean on branch; hardware abort path unexercised.

proposals.title: Async submit is fire-and-forget; tag is the correlation key
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-004 to state the handle is echoed in the completion (not returned synchronously) and clients correlate via the caller-supplied tag.

proposals.title: nvme_version / max_transfer_size / numa_id are fixed constants
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-010 and SC-005 to document that these three fields are currently fixed (1.0.0 / 131072 / 0) pending hardware discovery (align-task BD-2); other fields are real.

proposals.title: Controller NUMA node hardcoded to 0
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-013/SC-007 to document that pinning targets node 0 because controller NUMA discovery is unimplemented; real discovery tracked in BD-2.

proposals.title: on_stop order is drain then park, not park then drain
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-028 to the implemented drain -> Error{Aborted} -> park order (race-free: submission already stopped).

proposals.title: Unspecced read_write_stats() / ReadWriteStats
proposals.proposed_resolution: Add FR-030 documenting per-direction byte/op/latency counters, complementing FR-011 aggregate telemetry.

proposals.title: Remove unused crossbeam-channel dependency + fix stale bench doc comments
proposals.proposed_resolution: Remove crossbeam-channel from Cargo.toml; correct benches/{latency,throughput}.rs doc comments to describe the 256-slot SpscChannel.
proposals.verification: cargo build + cargo bench --no-run clean after removal.

proposals.title: Sync QD1 realized by actor serialization, not worker submit-one-wait
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-022 to clarify the worker pipelines to --queue-depth even in sync mode; QD1 is actor-side.

proposals.title: Per-sub-op latency timing, not aggregate-per-batch
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill FR-024 to state latency is measured per sub-op; retained behavior.

proposals.title: Telemetry cross-check clause unwired (telemetry feature off)
proposals.proposed_resolution: Backfill SC-006 to state stats come from client-side timestamps; telemetry cross-check tracked in BD-3.
